info.title: Microweber Headless API
info.description: JSON API for Microweber modules. Authenticate with a Passport personal-access token sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, or with a full OAuth2 flow via the `passport` security scheme. Most read endpoints are publicly accessible and rate-limited via the `public` throttle; write endpoints require `auth:api` plus the `api` throttle.

post.summary: Apply a coupon to the cart
Validate checkout before placing the order
Calculate shipping cost for a cart

get.summary: Look up the status of a placed order

bearerAuth.description: Laravel Passport personal-access token. Issue one from the admin under Account → API Applications, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

passport.description: Laravel Passport OAuth2 — authorization-code flow for third-party apps and password grant for first-party clients.
